sourceText: User requested implementing the evidence-activated advisory playbook promotion story because the prior auto-promotion guard was default-off and unusable; the fix must not ship another fake disabled feature.
normalizedOutcome: A qualified advisory playbook candidate with clean lineage, explicit exposure/outcome evidence, applied recommend_activate decision, and reviewed policy is activated by playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply --json, while unqualified candidates remain blocked.
acceptanceClaim: The local smoke proves playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply --json returns activatedCount 1 for an evidence-qualified candidate, writes one non-authoritative activation audit row, runtime consumption sees the active playbook, repeated apply writes no duplicate, and DONE-only or missing evidence never activates.
